intro: The Call of Fire is an elemental trial where an initiate drinks a prepared sapta to perceive and confront a Minor Manifestation of Fire. By subduing the spirit and placing its embers into the sacred brazier, the petitioner earns the favor of the flame.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fire sapta's ready, friend. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.
Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.
Blackrock Mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.
You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the peak of the looming mountain.
